name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
summary: A harder glute bridge on one leg that trains the glutes and hip stability. Do the two-leg bridge first if you are new.
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip width apart.
Lift one leg and hold the knee bent over your hips or the leg extended in line with the other thigh.
Brace your abs and keep your arms by your sides.
execution: Press through the heel of the grounded foot and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips level and do not let the free side drop.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.
mistakes: Arching the lower back: tuck the pelvis and stop when the body is in a straight line.
Hips rotating or dropping to one side: brace the abs and use a smaller range.
Pushing off the toes: keep the heel planted and the foot flat.
Struggling to hold form: go back to two-leg bridges.
